name: B47ANCE'd Earthworks

features.text: Standalone Lua-only excavation, spoil/backfill, gravel routes and surface wear; server validates shared work.
Deterministic dedicated Earthworks ZIP, no-dependency lock, archive preflight and two-client/restart checklist.
Vehicle/manual integration dropped. Old hooks are inert; saved markers and machine-only route definitions are retained without conversion.
Generic providers require explicit server registration/validation; no built-in vehicle mapping or fallback.
Native dedicated acceptance is NOT TESTED; experimental wheelbarrow pushing remains SP-only; no fluid simulation or custom cutaways.

limits: Reviewed Git authoritative source only; ignored historical Contents packages are excluded. Offline/source evidence only. Native dedicated NOT_TESTED, G7 and stable G8 BLOCKED. Dedicated first; SP optional.
